LanguageData.Raven_Item_MasturbatorCup.label: (Raven) Masturbation Cup
LanguageData.Raven_Item_MasturbatorCup.description:
A portable massager made from the Raven race's unique soft bionic materials. Its internal structure is incredibly complex, capable of simulating amazing textures and warmth.

The user can use it to relax their mind and body, achieving a much higher level of satisfaction than normal means.

Special function (requires setup): It seems to have a built-in quantum entanglement module, allowing it to establish a one-way sensory connection with a distant target.
